title: H_Chunks
description: Save ur Chunk history what chunks you are visited
body:
# h_chunks

h_chunks helping you see which chunks you have already visited in the current world or on the current multiplayer server. Visits are saved locally per world/server so you can pick up where you left off.

# 

### Features
- HUD chunk map — Small grid overlay (corner, size, and grid count are configurable) showing visited vs unvisited chunks around you.

- Data storage — Data is stored under your config folder, keyed by singleplayer world or multiplayer connection (and optionally by scoreboard “region” where supported).

- “Already visited” notice — Optional message when you step into a chunk you have been in before (can also be turned off in the settings)

- Scoreboard region (multiplayer, optional) — On servers where you enable it, saves can be separated by sidebar region (e.g. EU / NA) when the mod can detect it. Off by default; per-server setting. Not used in singleplayer. Some hostnames are excluded when region detection is unreliable.

- Settings screen — Language (from lang JSON files), HUD corner, scale, grid size, chunks per HUD grid square, toggles above, reset visits for the current session, and more.

### Requirements
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
